entries.back_en: "How... By what means did you find me?"
entries.note: Source 'find us' (royal we); target uses 'me encontrastes' (find me).

entries.back_en: "How... By what means did you find me?"
entries.note: Same: 'us' rendered as 'me'; should be 'nos encontrastes'.

entries.back_en: "It would appear... That you will not allow us to enter the Capital by any persuasion."
"It is true that we recovered only a portion of our power..."
"You should know that you, a mere mortal, pose no danger to us. A being such as I cannot be vanquished by a being such as you."
"Truth be told... Though my pride is repulsed by it, you speak truly. My path is clear-- I must hasten to the Capital before you find him!"
entries.note: 'fain admit' (willingly admit) reframed as 'pride repugns'; nuance shifted. 'lo' missing accent ('o').
